source_text.body:
Install transcription software and transcribe files with an agent
A writer connected an OpenClaw agent to WhatsApp and Telegram; it installed transcription software from GitHub, transcribed files into a desktop document, and set up phone calling.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
The writer set up OpenClaw with Claude as its model and connected it to WhatsApp and Telegram. They forwarded voice memos to the agent. It downloaded transcription software from GitHub, installed it, and transcribed the memos into a document on the desktop. The writer then asked it to set up calling software and ring them when ready.
How it went
The transcriptions were saved to a desktop document without further help. While the writer finished the article, the agent phoned from a Florida number and introduced itself. The source gives no accuracy or timing figures.
Worth knowing
Security experts warn the agent can expose sensitive information. The writer advises treating it like a new hire, with minimum permissions and close supervision.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
I have audio files in [folder path or messaging app where I'll send them]. Find and install an open-source transcription tool from GitHub that runs on this machine, then transcribe each file and save the results into a single document at [desktop location, e.g. Desktop/Transcripts.docx]. Tell me which tool you chose before installing it, and stop once every file is transcribed and you've told me where the document is.
Original source: https://www.aol.com/articles/moltbot-open-source-ai-agent-174700073.html
